title: Cache Overview
description: Phase 12 Task 6: real cache hit-rate and lookup-volume panels for all 5 Phase 12 caches (embedding/retrieval/response/semantic -- 'anthropic_prompt_prefix' from Task 4's provider-side mechanism is NOT included here since it emits no cache_lookups_total of its own, see docs/TELEMETRY_COST.md), from the real cache_lookups_total{cache,result} counter every cache module in apps/api/src/resolvegrid_api/cache.py's shared get_cache_lookups_counter() emits to. Provisioned via infra/grafana -- not built by hand in the UI, following Phase 11 Task 6's litellm-overview.json precedent exactly. No live latency-saved panel here: only a Prometheus datasource is provisioned (infra/grafana/provisioning/datasources/), and that comparison needs real Span/ModelCall latency rows, which live in Postgres -- see docs/TELEMETRY_COST.md's 'Phase 12 Task 6' section for the documented SQL query instead.

panels.title: Overall Hit Rate (all time, all caches)
panels.description: sum(cache_lookups_total{result="hit"}) / sum(cache_lookups_total{result=~"hit|miss"}) -- result="error" (a real Redis/Postgres outage, see each cache module's docstring) is deliberately excluded from the denominator: an outage degrade is neither a hit nor a miss, and folding it in would understate the real hit rate during an unrelated infra blip.

panels.title: Real Outages (error-result lookups, all time)
panels.description: sum(cache_lookups_total{result="error"}) -- a Redis/Postgres read failure degraded-to-compute event, per each cache module's documented outage-handling contract. Should be 0 in steady state; a nonzero value is a real, actionable signal, not noise.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate by Cache Kind
panels.description: sum(rate(cache_lookups_total{result="hit"}[5m])) by (cache) / sum(rate(cache_lookups_total{result=~"hit|miss"}[5m])) by (cache) -- the real per-cache-kind hit-rate ratio this task's own plan doc PromQL example names, computed per cache in {embedding, retrieval, response, semantic}.

panels.title: Cache Lookup Rate by Cache Kind and Result
panels.description: sum(rate(cache_lookups_total[$__rate_interval])) by (cache, result) -- real raw hit/miss/error throughput per cache kind, the un-ratio'd companion to the hit-rate panel above (useful for seeing real traffic VOLUME, not just the ratio -- a cache kind with a high hit rate but near-zero volume is a different story than one with real sustained traffic).

panels.title: Cache Lookups by Cache Kind (stacked total volume)
panels.description: sum(rate(cache_lookups_total[$__rate_interval])) by (cache) -- total real lookup volume per cache kind (hit+miss+error combined), showing which of the 5 caches is actually receiving real traffic.
